Evidence-backed observations

These statements are generated from the same aggregates shown above. They are descriptive associations, not causal claims.

  • At budget 1, XFG edge attack and XFG feature mask have the highest observed ASR (10.0%, 30/300 eligible scored cases).
  • At budget 3, XFG edge attack has the highest observed ASR (23.3%, 70/300 eligible scored cases).
  • At budget 5, XFG edge attack and XFG feature mask have the highest observed ASR (13.3%, 40/300 eligible scored cases).
  • targeted subgraph injection shows a constant budget-response pattern (6.7% at budget 1 versus 6.7% at budget 5).
  • XFG edge attack shows a non-monotonic budget-response pattern (10.0% at budget 1 versus 13.3% at budget 5).
  • XFG feature mask shows a non-decreasing budget-response pattern (10.0% at budget 1 versus 13.3% at budget 5).
  • targeted subgraph injection at budget 1 has the largest upward mean probability shift (+0.0057); XFG edge attack at budget 3 has the largest downward shift (-0.0542).
  • targeted subgraph injection at budget 5 produces the largest mean absolute node change (15.00), while targeted subgraph injection at budget 5 produces the largest mean absolute edge change (20.00).

Statistical evidence

Single-seed rates use 95% Wilson intervals. Multi-seed rate intervals are calculated across seed-level rates, so repeated variants are not presented as independent samples. Probability means use scored variant-level intervals.
